vb_textbox.text: I ended up picking the right hand gnome most of the time as I found the left hand gnome was a bit inconsistent when it came to the time I picked the gnome and the time I picked the mushrooms as to the amount of mushrooms picked. I found that picking the right hand gnome was more consistent with the most mushrooms picked depending upon the time spent picking the gnome and the time spent picking the mushrooms. I think that the time spent picking the right hand gnome was matched closely to the time spent picking the mushroooms as to the amount of mushrooms picked, the closer together the times the most mushrooms got picked. Having experimented with the gnome pick times on both sides to the amount of mushrooms picked I concluded that it was advisable to stay with the gnome I felt would yield the most mushrooms.
